items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...But they had a different clarinet where they had this Jules Gallo. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Jules. Jules Gallo.

ctx.x: When I saw them, they were at Baracell. Do you know where Baracell is? Right on the... It's on the beach, huh? On the beach, yeah. They were there for a while. But they had a different clarinet where they had this Jules Gallo.
Yeah, Jules. Jules Gallo. I don't know if that's why I wanted you up.
